outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/table (breast anatomy diagram and classification table), not a data plot requiring individual points.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating the study design, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic showing the experimental setup (luciferase recording), not a data plot.
Panel D shows stylized illustrative traces as part of a workflow schematic, not real quantitative data with averages.
Panel E is an illustrative heatmap icon representing the concept of correlation analysis within a schematic workflow, not actual experimental data.
Panel F contains a stylized illustrative growth curve as part of a method schematic, not real averaged experimental data requiring individual points.
Panel G contains a stylized illustrative dose-response curve as part of a method schematic, not real averaged experimental data.
Panel H shows illustrative heatmap/mutation-matrix icons representing the concept of genomic analysis, not actual data plots of averages.
Panel I shows illustrative PCA/3D scatter icons representing the concept of subtype clustering within a schematic, not an actual data plot of averaged measurements.
